name: VCU Data Management Limited
about: VCU Data Management Limited manufactures and trades in electronic security products in India. The company offers commercial and residential security and surveillance equipment. It also operates E-IPO Platform for investing. In addition, the company offers consultation, installation, and servicing solutions for security assessments, analog and IP security cameras, intercom and telephone entry systems, electrified gate operators, automated pedestrian door operators, and intrusion systems; and engineering and design services for the creation of business security products and systems. VCU Data Management Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Mumbai, India.
